hooks.command: DATE=$(date +%Y-%m-%d); STUB="docs/retros/${DATE}-session.md"; MSGS=(); if [ ! -f "$STUB" ] && [ -f docs/retros/_template.md ]; then cp docs/retros/_template.md "$STUB" && MSGS+=("Retro stub created: $STUB"); fi; DIRTY=$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | grep -E '\.(ts|tsx)$' | head -1); if [ -n "$DIRTY" ]; then if ! npm run typecheck >/tmp/claude-tsc-last.log 2>&1; then MSGS+=("typecheck failed (see /tmp/claude-tsc-last.log): $(tail -2 /tmp/claude-tsc-last.log | head -1 | cut -c1-120)"); fi; fi; if [ ${#MSGS[@]} -gt 0 ]; then jq -nc --arg msg "$(printf '%s\n' "${MSGS[@]}")" '{systemMessage:$msg}'; fi; exit 0
hooks.statusMessage: Stop hook: retro stub + typecheck if dirty

hooks.command: { LATEST=$(ls -1t docs/retros/[0-9]*.md 2>/dev/null | head -1); [ -n "$LATEST" ] && { echo "### Latest retro: $LATEST"; cat "$LATEST"; echo; }; [ -f .codex-artifacts/eval/latest/report.md ] && echo "### Latest eval report: .codex-artifacts/eval/latest/report.md"; } | jq -Rs 'select(length > 0) | {hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:.}}'
hooks.statusMessage: SessionStart hook: load latest retro + eval report

hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); [ -z "$f" ] && exit 0; case "$f" in app/*|components/*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; case "$f" in *.css|*.tsx) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; echo '{"systemMessage":"UI file touched. Before claiming done: run npm run capture:ui and Read the affected screenshot from .codex-artifacts/eval/latest/ui/ to verify rendered output. Flush-to-edge, alignment, hierarchy problems are invisible without seeing the result."}'
